+
+**Problem:** The profile bridge builds all Contracts sources, Builds imports and Commons dependencies. Authenticated publication refuses because its bindings do not cover that executable graph.

+## Boundaries & Constraints

Bind new controls/sources in authenticated inputs. Build only verified snapshots with explicit compile items, no project/package references, private outputs, cleared package sources, disabled ancestor build/central-package imports and no build servers. Keep SDK generators. Use Debug locally, Release in CI. Preserve the existing installed-toolchain trust boundary; local hashes authenticate nothing.
+
+**Never:** Fork profile semantics, duplicate codecs, follow nested submodules, fetch fallback packages, accept caller commands/properties or compile mutable checkout bytes. +| Unrelated Contracts source or ancestor build/package configuration | Never compiled, imported or executed |
+| Unavailable SDK/targeting pack, package fallback or no-op child | Refuse safely; no cached result or success from exit zero alone |

+installed toolchain, and do not supply the publication build-input proof.

+import hashlib

+import os

+import tempfile

+CONFIG = BRIDGE + "/NuGet.Config"

+class Refusal(Exception):
+    """Safe diagnostic without caller-controlled values or child diagnostics."""
+    def __init__(self, code="PROFILE_BUILD_INPUT_INVALID"):
+        super().__init__(code)
+        self.code = code
+
+
+def require(value, code="PROFILE_BUILD_INPUT_INVALID"):
+    if not value:
+        raise Refusal(code)
+
+
+def safe_path(path):
+    require(isinstance(path, str) and len(path) <= 512
+            and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.@/-]+", path) is not None and not path.startswith("/")
+            and all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in path.split("/")))
+
+
+def no_symbolic_ancestors(path):
+    require(all(not part.is_symlink() for part in (path.absolute(), *path.absolute().parents)))
+
+
+def read(root, relative, maximum=MAX_FILE):
+    safe_path(relative)
+    candidate = root / relative
+    no_symbolic_ancestors(candidate)
+    parent_fd = None
+    try:
+        # Anchor every ancestor without following links, including during opens.
+        parts = candidate.absolute().parts
+        require(all(part not in (".", "..") for part in parts))
+        parent_fd = os.open(parts[0], os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+        for part in parts[1:-1]:
+            next_fd = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent_fd)
+            os.close(parent_fd)
+            parent_fd = next_fd
+        # O_NONBLOCK prevents a substituted FIFO from hanging.
+        fd = os.open(parts[-1], os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=parent_fd)
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
+            require(stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_mode))
+            content = stream.read(maximum + 1)
+        require(0 < len(content) <= maximum)
+        return content
+    except OSError as error:
+        raise Refusal() from error
+    finally:
+        if parent_fd is not None:
+            os.close(parent_fd)
+
+
+def source_paths(root):
